readerCopy.body: A desire kept small for a long time can become much louder once permission and possibility arrive together. When Jupiter conjoins Lilith, expansion and autonomy fuse, amplifying appetite around freedom, money, attention, travel, sexuality, or the right to live differently. The enlargement may be overdue and can also make every limit resemble the rules that were previously oppressive. Freedom works better when the desire enters the plan without making restraint automatically suspect.
